feature.createplus.build_selection.name: Selection Wand
feature.createplus.build_selection.descr: Left click sets corner 1, right click sets corner 2; shared by fill, copy and export
feature.createplus.speed_build.name: Fast Place
setting.createplus.speed_build.delay.too: In ticks. 0 means no cooldown at all, vanilla uses 4.
feature.createplus.infinite_placement.de: Keeps the held stack topped up in creative mode
feature.createplus.area_fill.name: Area Fill
feature.createplus.area_fill.description: Fills the selection with the held block; hollow, walls, frame and undo supported
setting.createplus.area_fill.per_tick.to: Higher is faster, but flooding packets can get you kicked.
feature.createplus.area_copy.name: Area Copy
feature.createplus.area_copy.description: Copy the selection and paste it elsewhere, with rotation and mirroring
feature.createplus.mirror_build.name: Symmetry Build
feature.createplus.mirror_build.descript: Mirrors every block you place across a plane
feature.createplus.placement_restriction: While holding use, locks placement to one layer, face or line
setting.createplus.placement_restriction: The anchor is the first block placed after holding use; releasing use picks a new one.
feature.createplus.shape_studio.name: Shape Studio
feature.createplus.shape_studio.descript: Parametric spheres, tori, helices and arches with a live hologram preview
setting.createplus.shape_studio.thicknes: Shell thickness when hollow; doubles as the tube radius for a torus.
feature.createplus.curve_builder.name: Spline Builder
feature.createplus.curve_builder.descrip: Drop control points, get a smooth curve, then thicken it into a tube
setting.createplus.curve_builder.tension: 0 is the roundest; higher values straighten it towards a polyline.
feature.createplus.paint_palette.name: Texture Palette
feature.createplus.paint_palette.descrip: Blends several blocks with coherent noise instead of one flat material
setting.createplus.paint_palette.patch_s: Rough diameter of a single-material patch; smaller is noisier.
setting.createplus.paint_palette.seed.to: A different number reshuffles the patches without changing the shape.
feature.createplus.area_place.name: Brush Place
feature.createplus.area_place.descriptio: Hold use to place a patch of blocks around the crosshair
feature.createplus.nucker.name: Brush Break
feature.createplus.nucker.description: Hold attack to break blocks around the crosshair
feature.createplus.block_color_swap.name: Block Swap
feature.createplus.block_color_swap.desc: Hold the modifier and scroll to cycle through related blocks
feature.createplus.building_export.name: Build Export
feature.createplus.building_export.descr: Export the selection to a .mcfunction file and import it back
feature.createplus.scaffold.name: Scaffold
feature.createplus.scaffold.description: Places blocks under your feet so you can walk on air
setting.createplus.scaffold.tower.toolti: Hold jump to rise straight up while blocks are placed below you.
feature.createplus.improved_flight.name: Flight Feel
feature.createplus.improved_flight.descr: Creative flight stops the moment you release the keys
Fraction of horizontal speed kept each tick; 0 stops immediately.
feature.createplus.speed_adjust.name: Speed Adjust
feature.createplus.speed_adjust.descript: Custom walk, fly, swim, elytra and mount speed
feature.createplus.extended_reach.name: Extended Reach
feature.createplus.extended_reach.descri: Increases interaction range (creative only; syncs to integrated server)
feature.createplus.noclip.name: NoClip
feature.createplus.noclip.description: Walk through blocks (creative only; works on integrated and remote as far as possible)
setting.createplus.noclip.ignore_rubberb: Drop server position corrections and keep sending yours. Strict anticheat may kick.
feature.createplus.spinbot.name: SpinBot
feature.createplus.spinbot.description: Spins the body server-side while your view stays put
feature.createplus.snap_aim.name: Snap Aim
feature.createplus.snap_aim.description: Snaps your view to fixed angles so directional blocks line up
setting.createplus.snap_aim.yaw_step.too: 45° gives the eight compass directions, 90° only the four cardinal ones.
feature.createplus.freecam.name: Freecam
feature.createplus.freecam.description: Detach the camera and fly around; your body stays behind
feature.createplus.zoom.name: Zoom
feature.createplus.zoom.description: Hold the zoom key to magnify; scroll to change the factor
feature.createplus.gamma_override.name: Full Bright
feature.createplus.gamma_override.descri: Raises screen brightness far beyond the vanilla limit
setting.createplus.gamma_override.bright: Vanilla caps at 1.0; this goes up to 20.
feature.createplus.chunk_borders.name: Chunk Borders
feature.createplus.chunk_borders.descrip: Shows chunk borders, sub chunk layers and a 4x4 grid
feature.createplus.light_overlay.name: Light Overlay
feature.createplus.light_overlay.descrip: Marks blocks where mobs can spawn
setting.createplus.light_overlay.refresh: In ticks; lower reacts faster but costs more performance.
feature.createplus.time_weather.name: Time & Weather
feature.createplus.mini_hud.name: Info HUD
feature.createplus.mini_hud.description: Shows coordinates, chunk, biome and more in a screen corner
Opacity for the info HUD and F9 quick menu
feature.createplus.hud_editor.name: HUD Editor
feature.createplus.hud_editor.descriptio: Enter HUD layout edit mode; drag panels to avoid overlap. Exit with F8 only
createplus.hud_edit.title: HUD Edit Mode
createplus.hud_edit.hint_f8: Drag panels · Right-click to reset · Press F8 to exit
feature.createplus.block_info.name: Block Inspector

feature.createplus.ping_display.name: Ping Display
feature.createplus.ping_display.descript: Shows latency on name tags and on screen
feature.createplus.air_place.name: Air Place
feature.createplus.air_place.description: Place blocks while aiming at empty air (creative only)
feature.createplus.measure_ruler.name: Measure Ruler

feature.createplus.waypoints.name: Waypoints
feature.createplus.waypoints.description: Beacon beams and automatic breadcrumbs (creative only)
setting.createplus.waypoints.auto_interv: 0 disables automatic crumbs; manual pins still work.
feature.createplus.step_assist.name: Step Assist
feature.createplus.step_assist.descripti: Step up full blocks automatically (creative only)
feature.createplus.fast_break.name: Fast Break
feature.createplus.auto_pick.name: Auto Pick
feature.createplus.auto_pick.description: Middle-click picks full block state and NBT (creative only)
feature.createplus.camera_clip.name: Camera Clip
feature.createplus.camera_clip.descripti: Third-person camera passes through blocks (creative only)
feature.createplus.storage_esp.name: Storage ESP
feature.createplus.storage_esp.descripti: Outlines nearby containers through walls (creative only)

feature.createplus.auto_bridge.name: Auto Bridge
feature.createplus.auto_bridge.descripti: Automatically places blocks under your feet while walking (creative only)
feature.createplus.liquid_walk.name: Liquid Walk

feature.createplus.performance.descripti: Rendering switches that trade visuals for frames (Graphene-inspired)
feature.createplus.state_clipboard.name: State Clipboard
feature.createplus.state_clipboard.descr: Copy and paste full block states (creative only)
feature.createplus.hotbar_random.name: Hotbar Random
feature.createplus.hotbar_random.descrip: Pick a random hotbar block while holding right-click (creative only)
feature.createplus.look_replace.name: Look Replace

feature.createplus.flood_fill.name: Flood Fill
feature.createplus.command_studio.name: Command Studio
feature.createplus.command_studio.descri: AI command/OOC generation and NBT autocomplete (client-only, never auto-runs)
createplus.command_studio.title: CreatePlus Command Studio
createplus.command_studio.ai_prompt: Describe the command or OOC you want…
feature.createplus.map_art.name: Map Art
feature.createplus.map_art.description: Turn an image into filled_map art and write it to Saved Hotbars (SP or MP client)
createplus.map_art.title: CreatePlus Map Art
createplus.map_art.hint: Pick image → set grid/scale → generate; can auto-place wall+frames+maps
createplus.map_art.path_hint: Or paste a full image path…
